metric_semantics.reward: Raw accepted training reward, task mix changes after algorithm-dependent admission; not held-out evaluation.
metric_semantics.ppo: Learned critic, native mask-aware GAE; raw rewards; gamma=lambda=1; whitened advantages; clipped policy/value loss.
metric_semantics.ipo: Centered group rewards with zero-advantage filtering. Its custom entropy metric is a zero placeholder, not measured entropy.
metric_semantics.memory: nvidia-smi device allocated HBM, distinct from trainer peak allocator memory.
metric_semantics.ib: PMA counters use four-byte units. Rates are counter differences / elapsed time. Each port is separate; TX/RX are not added together.
metric_semantics.time: Different framework timer boundaries, compilation/cache state, and generated work prevent an isolated loss-function speedup claim.
metric_semantics.missing: Omitted/null, never converted to zero. Unsupported collectors and missing historical measurements are listed.
metric_semantics.checkpoints: Weights-only. No optimizer/RNG/scheduler resume fidelity claim.
metric_semantics.weight_transfer: update_weights timers include the native broadcast path but exclude the separately recorded actor wake_up/sleep transfers.
metric_semantics.sglang_scope: The node-3 serving endpoint exposes DP0 scheduler gauges and API-level token counters. Do not interpret the queue gauge as a complete DP0+DP1 queue.
metric_semantics.staleness: Synchronous Miles driver, one actor update per batch. Fully asynchronous queue/staleness benchmark not performed.
metric_semantics.summary_statistics: Linearly interpolated sample quantiles; population CV. Samples are correlated, not independent benchmark repetitions.
